review_notes.http_inventory: http_matrix.tsv freezes the current 166 operation plan. Credential, HEAD and staff probes are real HTTP negative checks. Selected functional outcomes, other permission and target variations, Go and TS bindings, and open-tier functional contracts remain under review.
review_notes.media: Focused actual image, S3, multipart and gateway checks pass. Owner quota, expired tickets, worker process crashes, concurrent edits, HLS and archives, retention purge, and all named and inline variants remain.
review_notes.browser: The built package, real React identity changes, delayed network responses and TS image ingest pass. The remaining client matrix and declared error, retry and header metadata need coverage. RequestID is a Go field, outside the current TS ContentKitError contract.
review_notes.erasure: A real ClickHouse connection cut leaves erasure incomplete; recovery clears only the target subject; late signals remain fenced. Restored app backups, paused writers, shared avatars and inboxes, and sibling app retries remain.
review_notes.qualification: All123 scenario statuses remain pending semantic and operation review. The default runner intentionally refuses qualification; focused execution is explicitly partial.
review_notes.upstream: Normal signed merge of8377f8b3 preserved media runtime. HTTP identities remain166. POST content publish and PUT text no longer advertise202 or moderation_rejected; comment moderation remains current. P0 purge CK-J08-S05/S06 activated; P1 audio deferred.
review_notes.bindings: binding_matrix.tsv freezes the selected public contract:115Go and115TypeScript bindings (230total). Every binding remains pending; invocation alone does not establish functional, error, alias or transport coverage.
